headline: T-Swift's Baddies Drop a Deuce-Thirteen, 226 Alpha Drops Trou
subhead: Week 5 was less a slate of football games and more a series of public executions, with three teams clearing 180 and one team forgetting it was playing.
matchOfTheWeek: LargestofRocks 123.88 vs Put an AR to My Head 114.56 — the only matchup that didn't end in war crimes. Largest left 34.62 points on the bench including a 22-point Daniel Jones game (yes, that sentence happened in 2024) and STILL won, which tells you everything about the AR offense this week. Kyle, putting the gun to your own head was the only correct read.
powerRankingsShakeup: T Swift's Baddies just dropped 213 and are officially the scariest team in the league; 226 Alpha is in freefall after posting a league-low 114 in a week where the average was somewhere near a Big 12 final score.
mainRecap:
Let's start at the top because Tnicolle just put 213.28 on the board and we need to talk about it. Kirk Cousins (35), Lamar (33), Drake London (33) — and she STILL left a 22-point Alec Pierce on the bench like it was nothing. That's not a fantasy lineup, that's a flex. Szara, brother, 114 points and you got beat by 99. Your team didn't lose, it filed a missing persons report.

Over in degenerate-ville, Hot Cocks hung 183 on OnlyFants behind Ja'Marr Chase's 41.30 nuke — and BigD somehow STILL left 44 combined points on the bench between Tucker Kraft (26.8) and Isaiah Likely (17.8). You won by 40 and it should've been 80. Cubby, Garrett Wilson went for 29 and you still got bodied — when your WR1 ghosts you AND your league-leader still cooks, that's just the universe telling you to log off.

Bo Nix Celli posted 185 with 100% lineup efficiency, which is the most insufferable stat line possible. Brock Bowers 27, DJ Moore 27, and Celli walking around like he's Bill Belichick. Meanwhile MassiveCocks put up 120 and got run off the field — Tee Higgins dropped 29 and it was the football equivalent of bringing a knife to a drone strike.

The Good Ladds quietly handled Jets' Juniors 157-131 thanks to Darnell freaking Mooney going for 31.50 as a Giant, a sentence that should not exist in any timeline. Wunder, your juniors got tutored.

And Olave Garden squeaked past Stroud Boys 142-133 on the back of Burrow's 34.78. Bjewett, you lost by nine in a week where six teams scored 140+. The bar is on the floor and you brought a limbo stick.

weeklyAwards.title: Nuke of the Week
weeklyAwards.blurb: Ja'Marr Chase 41.30 — and BigD still left 44 on the bench because greatness is wasted on the careless.

weeklyAwards.title: Crime Scene Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: Lost by 99.28 and left a 21-point Jalen Tolbert benched — Szara coached this one from the parking lot.

weeklyAwards.title: Cooked With What She Had
weeklyAwards.blurb: 213.28 with two QBs over 33 and Drake London going supernova — Tnicolle is officially the league boogeyman.

weeklyAwards.title: Won Anyway, Idiot
weeklyAwards.blurb: Left 34.62 on the bench including a 22-point Daniel Jones — escaped Kyle by the skin of his teeth and the grace of God.
